preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The input must contain exactly n lines after the first line (n-1 edges).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n and int(v) != int(u) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices in the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(set((int(v), int(u)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()])) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The input edges must form a tree (no cycles, connected, and exactly n-1 edges).

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each k in 0 ≤ k ≤ n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 1000000006 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be a non-negative integer modulo 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.split()[i]) <= 1000000006 for i in range(n)) and sum(int(stdout.split()[i]) for i in range(n)) == 1000000006 * n // 2 if n > 2 else 1
postconditions.description: The sum of all output values must equal the total number of labeled trees with n vertices modulo 1000000007 (which is n^(n-2) mod 1000000007 by Cayley's formula).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.split()[k]) <= 1000000006 for k in range(n)) and sum(int(stdout.split()[k]) for k in range(n)) == 1000000006 * n // 2 if n > 2 else 1
postconditions.description: The output must correctly count the number of labeled trees with n vertices that share exactly k edges with Will's tree for each k in 0 ≤ k ≤ n-1.
